name: Rewrite Guard
input: Pre-paired original and revised copy CSV
bottleneck: Spotting changed meaning and numeric promises before releasing edited content
AI: Real local MiniLM embedding similarity per existing pair
output: Human-reviewed release/hold register with unchanged sources and chosen final copy

distinctFrom.Revision Dock: No cross-version obligation assignment, additions or one-to-one linking; input pairs already exist and undergo semantic plus numeric release QA.
distinctFrom.Coverage Desk: No requirement/evidence matching or coverage claims.
distinctFrom.Queue Mosaic: No audit sampling or selection budget; every paired edit receives a review decision.
